summary_md: **meng shao ([@shao__meng](https://x.com/shao__meng/status/2115975663148765204))** summarizes Alibaba Cloud's open **AI Agent Handbook** on using harnesses to take enterprise agents from pilot to governed production, with survey figures such as ~18% in production, ~90% needing context/memory, only ~8% using trajectory-based automatic evaluation, and MCP gaps in registries, auth, versioning, audit and gateways ([aliyun/ai-agent-handbook](https://github.com/aliyun/ai-agent-handbook)).
